data.title: Your data
data.countsHint: Download a snapshot of your tasks and epics.
data.formatJson: JSON mirrors the API shape, including derived fields (spentHours, estimatedHours, progress).

data.formatEpicsCsv: Epics CSV is one row per epic with rolled-up totals.
data.formatIcs: Calendar (.ics) emits one VEVENT per scheduled time block and one VTODO per task with a due date — drop the file into Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, or Outlook for a read-only mirror.

danger.title: Danger zone

danger.itemMoney: Money ledger, savings goals and budgets
danger.itemUploads: Uploaded files, your profile and every signed-in session
danger.permanent: There is no recycle bin and no grace period. The operator keeps no copy.
danger.googleOnlyHint: This account signs in with Google, so the typed address is the only confirmation needed.
danger.deleted: Your account and its data are gone.
